paper_title: Direct Search for Dark Matter Axions Excluding ALP Cogenesis in the 63-67 micro-eV Range, with The ORGAN Experiment
notes: ORGAN Phase 1a microwave cavity haloscope. New 95% CL limit g_agamma >= 3e-12 GeV^-1 over 63.2-67.1 ueV (15.28-16.23 GHz). Exact limit curve points along the mass range are in Fig. 4 but only the bounding value 3e-12 is given in text; data points approximate the flat exclusion line. Local DM density assumed 0.45 GeV/cm^3 (all axions). Gaps exist due to mode-mixing regions. | Vision: Plot shows projected limits (red dashed 2a-2g, blue/orange bands) and actual achieved limits as green vertical bands (1a ~14 GHz reaching g~3e-12, 1b ~27 GHz reaching g~1.2e-12). The green bands are the real constraints from this measurement; most other curves are projections. Frequency converted to mass via m[eV]=4.136e-15*f[Hz]. Excluded region is above the green band floors within those narrow mass windows. The dominant exclusion across whole range is CAST at ~6.6e-11. Confidence reduced because the actual exclusion regions are narrow green bands and y-axis values at band bottoms are approximate. | CV axis calibration succeeded (ranges consistent with LLM) | Calibration: No calibration needed (benchmark KSVZ raw_ratio=1.00 snapped to identity)
